content: {"summary":"Customers report frequent driver‑initiated cancellations, causing confusion and long wait times [#tk_327509, #tk_516731, #tk_573690]. Many drivers refuse rides after acceptance, citing distance or direction issues, leaving passengers stranded and charged [#tk_2363436, #tk_2844528, #tk_112948]. Some drivers even cancel mid‑trip, forcing users to cancel themselves and lose time [#tk_2237907, #tk_2968437]. The lack of reliable cancellation options and driver accountability is a major pain point for users, especially on long‑distance trips [#tk_2867737, #tk_639805]."}
